nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handler for full-text search over a session's chat events.

nodes.name: es_search_chat_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that searches a session's chat events matching the given search options.

nodes.name: session_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for switching, pinning/unpinning, evicting, and buffering events for sessions tracked by the event-store session manager.

nodes.name: es_switch_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that switches the active session in the event-store session manager.

nodes.name: es_pin_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that pins a session to keep it resident in memory.

nodes.name: es_unpin_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that unpins a previously pinned session.

nodes.name: es_evict_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that evicts a session's in-memory event store.

nodes.name: es_buffer_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that buffers incoming events for a session pending processing.

nodes.name: snapshot.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for retrieving a session's current event-store snapshot, raw events, or a markdown export.

nodes.name: es_get_snapshot
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the current event-store snapshot for a session.

nodes.name: es_get_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the raw event list for a session.

nodes.name: es_export_markdown
nodes.summary: Tauri command that exports a session's events as a markdown transcript.

nodes.name: store_commands.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for core mutating operations on a session's event store: set/append/upsert/update/merge/clear/truncate, plus repo-context configuration and streaming-state toggling.

nodes.name: es_set_repo_context
nodes.summary: Tauri command that sets the repo id/path context for a session's event store.

nodes.name: es_set
nodes.summary: Tauri command that replaces a session's entire event list.

nodes.name: es_append
nodes.summary: Tauri command that appends new events to a session's store with merge/backfill handling.

nodes.name: es_upsert
nodes.summary: Tauri command that inserts or updates a single event in a session's store.

nodes.name: es_update_by_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command that applies a patch to a single event identified by id.

nodes.name: es_merge_tool_results
nodes.summary: Merges tool-call result events into their corresponding call events.

nodes.name: es_merge_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges a batch of events into a session's store.

nodes.name: es_merge_round_window_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that merges events within a bounded round/turn window into a session's store.

nodes.name: es_set_streaming
nodes.summary: Tauri command that toggles a session's streaming-in-progress flag.

nodes.name: es_clear
nodes.summary: Tauri command that clears all events from a session's store.

nodes.name: es_truncate_before_id
nodes.summary: Tauri command that truncates a session's events, discarding everything before a given event id.

nodes.name: turn_window.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and loads paginated 'turn windows' (grouped user/assistant turns) for a session, including synthetic turn-header and placeholder events and lazy body loading.

nodes.name: turn_has_user_header
nodes.summary: Checks whether a turn already has a synthetic user-header event present.

nodes.name: make_turn_user_header_event
nodes.summary: Builds a synthetic user-header event summarizing a turn's user message for display.

nodes.name: make_turn_placeholder_event
nodes.summary: Builds a placeholder event representing an unloaded turn's body, to be lazily hydrated.

nodes.name: cache_load_session_turn_body
nodes.summary: Loads the full body events for a single turn from the cache.

nodes.name: load_initial_turn_window_events
nodes.summary: Loads the initial window of recent turns and their events for a session.

nodes.name: cache_load_session_initial_turn_window
nodes.summary: Loads the initial turn window for a session directly from the cache.

nodes.name: es_load_initial_turn_window
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the initial turn window (recent turns plus events) for a session.

nodes.name: es_unload_turn_body
nodes.summary: Tauri command that unloads a turn's body events from memory to save space, leaving a placeholder.

nodes.name: SessionTurnBodyWindow
nodes.summary: A single turn's id paired with its (possibly lazily-loaded) body events.

nodes.name: SessionInitialTurnWindow
nodes.summary: The initial set of turns and events loaded for a session on open.

nodes.name: derived.rs
nodes.summary: Computes derived, display-oriented state from a session's raw events: chat/simulator visibility filters, display status/variant mapping, canvas preview, and simulator preview indexes.

nodes.name: is_live_runtime_resource_event
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event represents a live runtime resource (e.g. a running shell process) requiring special handling.

nodes.name: is_visible_in_chat
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event should be visible in the main chat view.

nodes.name: is_visible_in_simulator_or_messages
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event should be visible in either the simulator view or the messages view.

nodes.name: display_variant_wire
nodes.summary: Maps an internal event display variant to its wire/serialized representation.

nodes.name: latest_canvas_preview
nodes.summary: Finds the most recent canvas-preview-eligible event to show as a live preview.

nodes.name: build_simulator_preview_indexes
nodes.summary: Builds lookup indexes (by event id) used to render simulator previews efficiently.

nodes.name: build_simulator_preview_indexes_from_iter
nodes.summary: Builds simulator preview indexes from an iterator of sorted simulator events, avoiding a full materialized copy.

nodes.name: compute_derived
nodes.summary: Computes the full set of derived display state for a session's events at a given version.

nodes.name: has_thinking_content
nodes.summary: Checks whether a tool/model result contains visible 'thinking' content.

nodes.name: has_visible_message_content
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event has visible message content to render.

nodes.name: sort_if_unsorted
nodes.summary: Sorts a session's events by chat order only if they are not already sorted, avoiding unnecessary work.

nodes.name: sort_simulator_events
nodes.summary: Sorts events specifically for simulator-view chronological ordering.

nodes.name: SimulatorPreviewIndexes
nodes.summary: Precomputed lookup indexes (previews, timestamps, thread ids, function names, display status/variant) keyed by event id for fast simulator rendering.

nodes.name: extractors.rs
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data, including tool-call-specific args/result summaries, from raw session events in single and batch form for lightweight frontend consumption.

nodes.name: extract_event_data
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data for a single event.

nodes.name: extract_tool_call_data
nodes.summary: Extracts and formats tool-call-specific display data (arguments and result) from an event.

nodes.name: extract_batch
nodes.summary: Extracts normalized display data for a batch of events.
